summary: security checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed, with a blocked decision for security-sensitive releases and gated public exposure. Evidence: security baseline has no fleet-doctor run, operations has no deploy/uptime/error sweep results, all 59 managed sites have unknown legal-family evidence, and no credential, secret-scan, private-container, dependency, isolation, or incident-readiness evidence is available. Compliance confirms HTTPS for checked sites but does not establish complete TLS, access, release, or data-exposure controls. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only if it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not claim certification or a clean bill of health.

Required decision: retain the existing read-only security evidence matrix and preserve release gates. Complete or attach authorized evidence for authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, TLS configuration, dependency and supply-chain provenance, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.

For SearchWoot and any comparable gated product, keep public exposure private and preview-only. Security evidence is incomplete and the launch checklist already records security and release as blocked. Reconsider only after direct evidence supports access control, secret handling, isolation, release integrity, TLS, dependency provenance, data-flow protection, monitoring/incident response, disclosure readiness, and owner-approved launch disposition.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition and security-sensitive release gates
items.summary: Fleet security clearance is unsupported, not because a vulnerability was confirmed, but because material controls are unevidenced. The security baseline reports fleet-doctor not run, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and the security snapshot has no credential, secret-scan, private-container, dependency, isolation, or incident-readiness evidence. HTTPS is evidenced in portions of the compliance baseline, but complete TLS and release-control evidence is absent.
items.requested_action: Continue the existing authorized read-only security evidence matrix. Record dated evidence, affected scope, owner, severity, and release impact for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain risk, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Keep security-sensitive releases and gated public exposure blocked until material controls are evidenced. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or claim certification.
